title: Record the mixed-negative bound at t = 2
body:
## Summary
- The necessary count `5n >= 11t`, with `n` and `t` the same parity, is 3 at `t = 1` and 6 at `t = 2`. Five retained endpoints meet those counts.
- The same three-call spine uses 9 calls at `t = 3` against a bound of 7, and 12 calls on the balanced `t = 4` endpoint against a bound of 10. The two product tables agree on all 64 pairs. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. No shorter word is searched.
